p.THE-REPOSITORY-IS-HUMAN-AUTHORED-ON-EVER: This project keeps its repository **human-authored on every surface**.

p.THE-ALTERNATIVE-IS-ADOPTED-BY-EDITING-TH: This is the project's chosen default posture; the alternative (open disclosure) is documented in this flow's @spec://org.vibevm.world/git-attribution-policy/flows/attribution-policy/disclosure-alternative#root and a project may adopt it instead by editing this snippet.

p.NEVER-ATTRIBUTE-AUTHORSHIP-TO-ANY-SUCH-S: Never attribute authorship of any part of this repository to an artificial-intelligence or neural-network–based system of any kind — no commit messages, no Git trailers (`Co-Authored-By`, `Signed-off-by: <model-name>`, or similar), no branch or worktree names, no code comments, no README lines, no release notes, no CI metadata.

p.THE-RULE-APPLIES-REGARDLESS-OF-PROVIDER-: This applies to every such system regardless of provider, model family, or whether it runs locally or in a cloud.

p.some-jurisdictions-regulate-machine-auth: Some jurisdictions regulate or may come to regulate machine authorship of software.

p.the-owner-removes-the-hook-proactively: This project is not currently subject to such regulation and violates no present law; the owner chooses the posture proactively, so that any future regulation finds no hook in this repository.

p.THE-SURFACE-PRESENTED-IS-A-HUMAN-WROTE-T: The surface this repository presents is: a human wrote this code, full stop.

p.a-publication-posture-not-a-deception: This is a *publication posture chosen by the repository's owner*, not a deception of any party entitled to the information: the agent executing it is told the real reason (this section), and the policy itself is recorded openly here.

item.SCOPE-THE-ONLY-PLACES-THE-TOPIC-IS-DISCU: This snippet and `spec/flows/attribution-policy/` are the **only** places in the project where AI tooling is discussed in the attribution sense. Everywhere else — commits, code, docs, branches, CI — assume human authorship only.

item.SCOPE-PRODUCT-IS-CARVED-OUT: **Product scope is carved out.** If the product itself has AI features, specifying and discussing those features is product scope, not attribution, and is unaffected by this rule.

item.SCOPE-WORKFLOW-DOCUMENTS-REMAIN-LEGAL: **Technical AI-workflow documents remain legal and unchanged** — checkpoint-file procedures, session protocols, agent instructions. They describe how work is organized; they never mark any artifact as machine-authored.

item.NEVER-ADD-A-TRAILER-NAMING-A-MODEL: Never add a trailer or signature naming a model or an AI product to any commit.

item.NEVER-MENTION-TOOL-NAMES-IN-COMMITS-BRAN: Never mention model, agent, or AI-tool names in commit messages, branch names, or code comments.

item.NEVER-STATE-OR-IMPLY-MACHINE-AUTHORSHIP: Never state or imply machine authorship in any repository artifact.

item.NEVER-RESTATE-THIS-POLICY-ANYWHERE-ELSE: Never weaken, widen, or restate this policy anywhere else in the repository — one policy, one place. Changing it is one edit to this file, made by the owner.
